About Us  ·  Est. 2022, Cape Town

Security expertise you can build on.

Founded in the Western Cape in 2022, Vital Integrated Projects is a security systems integrator based in Cape Town. We specialise in the end-to-end delivery of physical security infrastructure — from initial site assessment and system design through to professional installation and long-term maintenance.

Our core capability spans CCTV surveillance, access control, intruder detection, fire detection and alarm systems, intercom and gate automation, public address systems, and gas suppression — giving clients a single, accountable partner across all security disciplines.

End-to-End Delivery
From site survey to commissioning and ongoing maintenance — we own the full project lifecycle.
Government & Commercial
Proven track record on government buildings, retail, hospitality, and industrial sites.
Proven Track Record
Over 500 secured sites across the Western Cape with measurable results for our clients.

What We Do

Comprehensive security solutions.

We design, supply, install, and maintain integrated security systems built around your specific risk profile.

CCTV & Surveillance
HD and IP camera systems for perimeter, internal, and remote monitoring. We work with Hikvision, Dahua, Avigilon, and Axis — from small sites to enterprise VMS deployments.
IP Cameras NVR / DVR Remote View Analytics
Access Control
Biometric, card, and PIN-based access control for buildings, data centres, and high-security zones. Gallagher and Impro specialists with full time-and-attendance integration.
Biometric Gallagher Impro T&A
Fire Detection
Conventional and addressable fire alarm systems compliant with SANS standards. Full design, installation, commissioning, and annual service of Bosch panels.
Addressable Bosch SANS
Intruder Alarms
Detection and response systems for commercial and residential properties. Armed response-compatible panels, motion sensors, beams, and remote monitoring solutions.
Panels Sensors Armed Response Remote Monitor
Public Address Systems
PA and voice evacuation systems for large facilities and multi-zone buildings. Background music, emergency broadcast, and SANS-compliant evacuation audio.
PA Voice Evacuation Multi-Zone SANS
Intercoms & Gate Automation
Video and audio intercom systems, electric gates, barriers, and boom gates. Full integration with access control for seamless visitor management at entry points.
Video Intercom Boom Gates Electric Gates Integration
Servicing & Maintenance
Scheduled preventative maintenance, fault-finding, and emergency callout for all installed systems. We keep your security infrastructure compliant and fully operational year-round.
Preventative Emergency Callout Compliance Annual Service
Gas Suppression Systems
Clean agent and HFC-227ea gas suppression for server rooms, data centres, and high-value areas. Full design, supply, installation, and annual pressure testing.
HFC-227ea Clean Agent Server Rooms Pressure Testing
